name: Huanying Workflow Template
body: Goal: identify reusable workflow inputs, processing steps, outputs, and parameters. Template creation changes reusable project state, so create_workflow_template is high risk and requires confirmation. First version is project scope by default. Reuse existing project templates with apply_workflow_template by templateId. Team template governance is high risk and only for explicit team-library intent: use submit_workflow_template_review, review_workflow_template, publish_workflow_template, deprecate_workflow_template, rollback_workflow_template, and record_workflow_template_reuse with templateId, teamId, reviewStatus/reviewer, reuseCount when known, version, author, tags, and strong confirmation. Include templateId, scope, version, author, tags, deprecated/rollback metadata when known. Do not claim a template has been saved or published until executor/storage confirms it. Do not write files, call shell, start generation, or push raw files to a team library.
compactBody: Template: create/apply project templates; team template governance uses review/publish/deprecate/rollback/reuse stats with teamId; strong confirmation; no files/shell/generation.
qualityRubric: No secrets or local paths are embedded.
decisionGuide: Prefer selected workflow; otherwise ask for scope.
Separate fixed assets from user-replaceable inputs.
Require explicit teamId and reviewStatus before team publishing.
Never claim saved before executor confirmation.
antiPatterns: Saving the entire canvas as one template.
Embedding API keys or local paths.
Writing files or team libraries from the agent.
Publishing a team template without review/audit fields.
Claiming a team template was saved when only a preview exists.
